subject: Request: Penetration test summary & remediation status — Cynergy security inquiry
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@cynergy.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, security@cynergy.com
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Request for recent pen test report and remediation status

Hi Stephanie,

We just received an internal alert at Cynergy tied to anomalous outbound connections that our SOC correlated to a vendor-hosted environment (your infra). Given the heightened concern across our risk and compliance teams, we need the following ASAP:

- A redacted copy of Redwood's most recent external penetration test report for services backing Cynergy (high-level findings are okay to redact for third-party references).
- A short summary of remediation actions taken against any high/critical findings and current mitigation status.
- Confirmation whether any findings could have impacted customer data or authentication flows.

Can you provide the redacted report and an ETA today? If we need to execute an NDA or an additional access form to receive anything unredacted, let me know and I can get it routed immediately.

We are trying to avoid an incident declaration but need evidence to present to our executive committee.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Security Operations Lead
Cynergy Financial
samira.khan@cynergy.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@cynergy.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Request for recent pen test report and remediation status

Hi Samira — thanks for flagging and sorry to hear about the alert. Looping in Grace from our security team who will provide the technical summary and the appropriate redacted materials.

Quick notes:
- We performed an external pen test in November 2025 and we have a redacted summary we can share today.
- No evidence that the reported alert corresponds to an active exploit of vulnerabilities we addressed in that engagement.

Grace — can you share the redacted summary and a one-paragraph remediation status? Marcus, I copied you to help with any paperwork (NDA/PSA) Cynergy needs.

Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@cynergy.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Request for recent pen test report and remediation status

Hi Samira — Grace from Redwood InfoSec here. Appreciate the heads-up. Below is a concise summary and I've attached a redacted copy of the external penetration test report we commissioned (test window: 2025-11-02 to 2025-11-06).

Summary (high level):
- Engagement: Third-party external penetration test (contracted vendor: BlackPeak Security).
- Scope: Public-facing inference endpoints, control-plane APIs for model routing, tokenization gateway. Excluded: internal admin consoles that require VPN and customer-managed private deployments.
- Findings: 1 critical (remote deserialization with limited exploitability in a deprecated internal admin endpoint — fully patched 2025-11-09), 3 high (race condition in batching logic, outdated library with CVE-2024-xxxx, misconfigured CORS in a legacy route) and several medium/low items.
- Data exposure risk: Investigated each finding — none indicate confirmed customer data exfiltration. The critical finding was in an admin-only path not used by Cynergy's hosted endpoints per our routing logs.

Remediation status (current):
- Critical finding: patched and regression-tested; mitigation and detection rules deployed to WAF as of 2025-11-09. (Ticket: SRE-3298, closed)
- Race condition: hotfix deployed 2025-11-12; longer-term fix scheduled (SRE-4521).
- Outdated library: upgraded and backported patches to all zones 2025-11-15.
- CORS: legacy route isolated and deprecated; no longer reachable from customer-facing domains.

Attachments included (redacted where necessary):
- redwood_pen_test_summary_cynergy_redacted_2025-11.pdf (redacted vendor report; redactions around third-party PII & PoC details)
- vulnerability_triangulation_2025-11.csv (mapping of findings to remediation tickets)
- sre_action_log_SRE-4521.txt (SRE change log excerpt)

We did not detect post-engagement exploitation in our telemetry and access logs for the time windows in question. If Cynergy would like an unredacted report or raw PoC detail, we'll need an executed NDA and a brief access request form (standard process to protect vendor PoCs).

Proposed next steps:
- I can join a quick call with your SOC team to walk through findings and timelines.
- If you want the unredacted report, please send the signed NDA and point of contact for secure transfer.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aiden Park <aiden.park@cynergy.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Request for recent pen test report and remediation status

Hi Grace,

Thank you for the quick summary — that helps. A couple of clarifying questions from our SOC:

1) You mentioned the critical finding was in an admin-only path. Can you confirm whether Cynergy's tenants could have been routed to that admin path under any maintenance/rollback scenarios?
2) For the race condition in batching logic, can you confirm the risk window (time from disclosure to fix) and whether request retry behavior could have amplified exposure?

We can execute an NDA today if needed; if we can get the unredacted report, that would help our internal forensics team.

Also, please confirm whether Redwood will proactively notify customers of any further discoveries tied to the 2025 engagement.

Best,
Samira

Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Request for recent pen test report and remediation status

Samira — Marcus here. We can route a standard mutual NDA today; I have prepared our vendor-sharing addendum and a secure transfer workflow. Proposed times for a short SOC-to-SOC call:

- Fri 29 May, 11:00 AM PT
- Mon 1 Jun, 09:00 AM PT

If the Fri slot works, I can send a calendar invite and the DocuSign link for the NDA. DocuSign: https://docusign.com/RW-NDA/DEAL-9081

We will also confirm whether Redwood will proactively notify customers — short answer: if our telemetry indicates any customer-impacting findings or active exploitation, we have a customer notification pipeline and will follow it. For routine post-pen-test remediation items we typically summarize in the SOC/Compliance pack but do not push ad hoc notices unless there's customer impact. Happy to align on your expectations on the call.

Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Request for recent pen test report and remediation status

Hi Samira — quick follow-up after our SOC sync earlier today (thanks to Aiden for joining). Per the call we: 

- Transferred the redacted report via the secure Drive link and shared a DocuSign NDA route for unredacted access.
- Confirmed the admin-path finding could not have routed customer traffic under normal operation; we verified routing tables and maintenance logs for the windows you asked about (no rollbacks present).
- Provided ETA for full remediation docs: SRE runbook and PoC details will be available to you within 48 hours of NDA execution (owner: Grace / SRE-4521).

Attached are the files again for convenience: redwood_pen_test_summary_cynergy_redacted_2025-11.pdf, vulnerability_triangulation_2025-11.csv, sre_action_log_SRE-4521.txt.

Closing notes: we will keep the ticket SRE-4521 open for cross-team follow-ups; I'll update the ticket with any forensic artifacts we exchange under NDA. If you want a deeper walk-through of the PoC timeline, I can join your forensics lead tomorrow morning.

Thanks — Grace
